acquisition_and_handling.acquisition_method: Direct download of the three exact CNINFO static original annual-report PDF URLs registered in 158.
acquisition_and_handling.text_extraction: pdftotext completed locally for each downloaded PDF.
acquisition_and_handling.custodian_content_treatment: No annual-report body or extracted text was opened, read, or interpreted by this custodian.
acquisition_and_handling.temporary_packet_retention: The packet directory is intentionally retained intact for the next authorized role.

cutoff_before_release_rule.eligible_packet: Only the FY2021, FY2022, and FY2023 original full annual-report PDFs listed in packet_contents, each published before the cutoff.
excluded_from_packet: FY2024 and later metadata, document bodies, and outcomes
cutoff_before_release_rule.release_condition: Release this packet only to the subsequent blind-investigator role for ex-ante reasoning; freeze that judgment before any outcome acquisition.

firewall_and_role_separation.custodian_role: Acquire and preserve only the registered pre-cutoff packet; do not interpret source contents or perform investment reasoning.
firewall_and_role_separation.blind_investigator_role: May use the released FY2021-FY2023 packet and separately authorized pre-cutoff evidence to form and freeze an ex-ante judgment.
firewall_and_role_separation.outcome_role: May acquire and assess post-cutoff evidence only after the blind judgment is frozen and may not influence candidate selection or pre-outcome reasoning.
firewall_and_role_separation.feedback_role: May compare the frozen judgment with outcome evidence only after outcome acquisition, focused on mechanism calibration rather than score-seeking.
custodian_prohibitions: campaign artifacts and reports beyond the registered selection file
external or browser sources beyond the three registered CNINFO PDF downloads
